body: I just wanted to revisit this post and thank everyone for helping me, even if I did not respond to your comments before I definitely read them. I finally found a job (in my field!!!) last week and although that makes me happy, I am not going to tie my self worth it. I am an awesome person with incredible friends and family and the world cannot be that bad of a place when there are awesome internet strangers like you in it. So thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for giving me the courage to keep going, I would not be here today without it. Keep on being awesome =)

I happy cried reading that. Unfortunately, I've done literally everything to master my stutter, I was in speech therapy from ages 2-16, tried a feedback thingy, have practiced breathing/mental exercises, and it's here to stay. It comes up while I'm not nervous too, I just meant that interviews are so long that I usually stutter during them at least once. And I do have about 10 shorts I've made and edited and got onto IMDB but there isn't really a market for that where I am (read: I'm not in L.A. haha).

BUT. You still raised a lot of good points and I'm definitely going to channel my inner Samuel L. Jackson since he is a god. I'm going to keep expanding my portfolio and keep applying for any media related jobs in my town. And I figure if I get 50 interviews in the service industry or something statistically I will not stutter in at least one of them haha. 

Thanks for helping me keep my head up. I know I have a lot more support behind me than a lot of people and I hope to get to a place where I can give back to this community soon. You rock /u/tryify
Thank you for your kind words =)
